title: Japanese Onamae Desktop service hacked
content_md:
The Japanese Onamae Desktop service has been hacked. Onamae Desktop Cloud is a Japanese VPS-type cloud service owned by GMO Internet Group.

via Mastodon https://linuxiarze.pl/japonska-usluga-onamae-desktop-zostala-zhakowana/
exclude_reason: Duplicate Polish repost of the already-covered Onamae Desktop Cloud incident.
